addons.name: CoA Item Search
addons.description: Search every item of the server by name or ID and add it to your bags with one click (a GM command, so it needs a GM account on your own server). Type /items in game.
addons.author: ilusixn
addons.license: Author's own addon, no separate licence file
addons.notes: Folders: CoAItemSearch and CoAItemSearch_Data (the item list, loaded on demand). Tested with release v1.1.

addons.name: CoA Teleports
addons.description: Browse every teleport (stock and CoA) and click to go. GM only, so it needs a GM account on your own server. Type /tp in game.
addons.author: ilusixn
addons.license: Author's own addon, no separate licence file

addons.name: Questie-X for CoA
addons.description: Quest helper: quest givers, objectives and turn-ins on the map and minimap, a quest arrow and a tracker, with a quest database generated from a Conquest of Azeroth server.
addons.author: Xurkon and the Questie team (Questie-X); Dandenas (CoA package)
addons.license: MIT (Questie-X, copyright Xurkon). Unofficial compatibility package.
warnings: Installs four folders that belong together: Questie-X, Questie-X-WotLKDB, Questie-X-AscensionDB and Questie-X-CoADB.
Another Questie (Questie, Questie-335, PE-Questie) must be removed first: two quest helpers fight each other. If you also use Zygor or TomTom, turn off one of the quest arrows.

addons.name: ElvUI for CoA
addons.description: A complete interface replacement (unit frames, bars, bags, chat) built for Conquest of Azeroth, with CoA class resource bars, a Who search and server messages.
addons.author: Elv and Bunny (ElvUI); Paddy187 (CoA build)
addons.license: No licence file in the package; ElvUI belongs to its authors and the Tukui project. See the repository.
warnings: ElvUI replaces most of the default interface. Remove any other ElvUI or Tukui first.
The package also holds two profile scripts (GenerateProfiles.bat and .ps1). The launcher never installs scripts: ElvUI itself works without them.

addons.name: WillItDie
addons.description: Predicts damage-over-time damage on your target and can learn direct spells, abilities and auto-attacks on custom CoA realms (3.3.5a port).
addons.author: Joe Greive; 3.3.5a port by Duff-SPP
addons.notes: The repository has no releases: the launcher installs one fixed commit and never moves to a newer one by itself.

addons.name: Azeroth_FR (French translation)
addons.description: French translation of Conquest of Azeroth: spells and talents of the 21 classes, quests, items, creatures, dialogues, interface windows, achievements and the character screens. This is a FRENCH translation: it puts the game in French while you play. Command: /azfr.
addons.author: LePetitDan and contributors (a players' project, not linked to Blizzard or the CoA team)
addons.license: MIT for the addon's code. The game texts it displays are NOT covered by that licence (they belong to Blizzard and to the CoA authors). Read the repository's LICENSE.
warnings: It is a translation: the game text is shown in French.
Also installs Interface/PTRXML (two files that translate the screens before you enter the world). In the game launcher's addon clean-up, leave the translation unticked, or it is removed.
Only the release zip is downloaded. The author's installer programs (.exe and Linux) are never downloaded or run.
addons.notes: Newest stable release (pre-releases are skipped). Installs every folder named Azeroth_FR* from the zip, so new data folders of later versions are picked up. Tested with v1.1.1.
